$comment: Versioned, auditable AI provider pricing. NEVER hardcode these numbers in business logic — import from cost.service.js, which reads this file. Bump `version` and `retrievedAt` whenever a provider changes prices, and keep the superseded entry in `history` so past invoices stay reproducible.

fx.source: Bangladesh Bank / TradingEconomics spot USD-BDT, 2026-07-22 close (123.425); rounded to 123.40
fx.note: Interbank spot. Card/PSP settlement of a USD-denominated AI bill typically adds 1.5-3% FX margin — see AI_COST_ASSUMPTIONS.md.

gemini-3.1-flash-lite.notes: EasyModerator production PRIMARY (llm.service.js:27 default; no LLM_GEMINI_LITE_MODEL is rendered into .env.prod). Image inputs bill at the text/image/video input rate; measured 1064 tokens per image (see AI_COST_ASSUMPTIONS.md).

gemini-3.1-pro-preview.notes: EasyModerator production FALLBACK TIER 2 (llm.service.js:28 default). 8x the input price and 8x the output price of the primary.

gemini-2.0-flash.notes: Shut down 2026-06-01. Still referenced as the DEFAULT cache model in gemini-cache.service.js:108.

gemini-2.0-flash-lite.notes: Shut down 2026-06-01. Still set as LLM_GEMINI_LITE_MODEL in the repo's .env.prod and .env.docker.

gpt-4.1-mini.notes: EasyModerator production FALLBACK TIER 3 (llm.service.js:29 default) and the FORCED provider for product-image attribute extraction (product-ai.service.js:66).

local-ngram.notes: embedding.service.js localEmbed() character-bigram hash. Zero marginal cost and zero semantic value — resolveProvider() falls back to this for ANY EMBEDDING_PROVIDER value outside {openai, gcp, http, tei}, including 'gemini' and 'google'.

gemini-embedding-2.notes: embedding.service.js getGeminiEmbedding default when EMBEDDING_PROVIDER=gemini. Free tier bills 0.
